correctness.rationale: The finite graph is explicitly defined by 12 arcs. The independently implemented face tests match on all 4096 subsets; exact face counts, 47 matched Hasse pairs, full 100-face gradient acyclicity, six critical cells and all four zero signed integer Morse boundary coefficients are reproducible by verify.py. Forman discrete Morse theory and the degree classification of maps \(S^1\) to \(S^1\) imply a genuine integral homotopy equivalence \(S^1\) wedge four \(S^2\), not merely rank equality. No unproved infinite inference is used.

value.rationale: The bowtie is the smallest simple graph formed by gluing two nontrivial cycles at exactly one vertex. A direct full homotopy calculation demonstrates that identifying a vertex changes multipath topology from the \(S^3\) join of disjoint bidirected triangles to a non-simply-connected \(S^1\) wedge four \(S^2\), thereby establishing a meaningful first cyclic gluing benchmark beyond the published path/single-polygon families. The full integral homotopy type, not only Betti counts, is determined.
